conditions_and_falsification.scope: Cover business narrative and selected price/cost sections reviewed; no new business-condition case or future profit scenario created. Other sections remain unread.

forecast_capability.share_scope: p100 describes daily calculated latest ordinary shares excluding treasury for forecast EPS, includes treasury for issued-share display. Do not substitute historical weighted-average TSR denominator (p54), period-end total or printed stock count into this EPS.
forecast_capability.split_scope: General retroactive adjustment is stated for data; actual split date/ratio and precise current calculation date are not established on six selected pages.

next_gaps: No complete author target formula/fair multiple/attainment horizon; EPS and historical identity do not complete a valuation scenario.
Issuer original forecast and author-calculation exact denominator/date remain distinct evidence needs.
CAPM input decomposition/averaging cutoff and forecast-period risk/return adoption require separate meaning review if ever used.

other_author_estimates.cost_of_equity_basis: CAPM, most recent 12-month average rather than spot
other_author_estimates.debt_cost_basis: 26/3 interest divided by beginning/end average interest-bearing debt, simplified method
other_author_estimates.note: Keep COE, average window, debt cost and WACC distinct; graph endpoints and report date do not establish exact calculation cutoff. Source calls these estimates only.

valuation_capability.formula_found: 株価=BPS×PBR / EPS×PER is used to decompose historical TSR/market-price changes; not author-selected fair multiples or a forecast price target.
valuation_capability.peer_comparison: p58 scatter uses market price/period-end BPS and market price/company-guidance EPS, not adopted fair PE.
valuation_capability.scope_limit: Target multiple/formula not established in selected six pages, not a whole-report absence claim.
